summary: Iteration 26 — verifying iter_25 skip-ping backend fix end-to-end + re-running blocked tests 3/4/5/6. Skip-ping backend fix (server.py:12331-12352) is VERIFIED working: 10 skip-pings do not decrement remaining_uses; sweat cap remains untouched (3x200 + 429). Muscle Gainer is uncapped — 4 consecutive MG gens return HTTP 200. However a NEW regression was uncovered against the iter_26 spec: 'mixed: 3 MG gens then 1 Sweat gen (should pass — MG calls don't count for the cap)' FAILS — the Sweat call returns HTTP 429 immediately because MG generations still insert into choose_for_me_usage and burn the user's 3/day Sweat budget. Frontend playwright re-runs for Tests 1/3/4/6 were BLOCKED by repeated re-appearance of onboarding modals ('A quick note' / 'I Understand' / '5 metrics — Connect / Maybe later') on every navigation to '/', preventing automated navigation to the Muscle gainer mood card. The iter_25 v3 cart-flavor-badge / cart-subtitle fix was already verified live in iter_25 itself and the cart.tsx code (lines 956-1022) is unchanged in this iteration, so no regression risk there. Deprecated packages detected: expo-av. Deprecated style props detected: shadow*, textShadow*, props.pointerEvents (carry-over from iter_24+25).

critical.issue: Muscle Gainer generations still INSERT into choose_for_me_usage (server.py:12361), so after 3 MG gens the user's 3/day cap is exhausted and the NEXT non-MG call (Sweat/Lazy/Outdoor/Explosive/Calisthenics) returns HTTP 429. Per iter_26 brief, MG calls should NOT count toward the cap — the cap is for OTHER moods only. Fix: gate the usage insert + counter increment behind 'not is_muscle_gainer' (mirror the is_skip_ping early-return pattern).

integration_issues.issue: Terms & Privacy ('Accept & Continue'), 'A quick note' ('I Understand'), and '5 metrics' ('Connect / Maybe later') modals re-appear on every page.goto('/') even within the same logged-in session, breaking automated playwright flows that need to navigate home multiple times (Tests 3/4/5/6 all require returning to home). Suggest persisting the onboarding-dismissed flag in AsyncStorage so it survives intra-session re-navigations.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of mixed-mood 429: server.py /choose-for-me/generate has two early-bail paths (admin, skip-ping) AND one cap-bypass path (muscle gainer), but the muscle-gainer path only bypasses the 429 RAISE — it still falls through to db.choose_for_me_usage.insert_one(usage_record) (line 12361) which increments the count for all moods sharing this collection. The 3/day cap counter is therefore poisoned by MG calls and triggers 429 for the next non-MG call. Mitigation: gate the insert. Pseudo-diff: `if not is_muscle_gainer:\n    await db.choose_for_me_usage.insert_one(usage_record)` placed around line 12361. The workout_record save into db.generated_workouts can remain unconditional (history is still recorded).
